correctness.rationale: For a defining quadratic f, Disc(f)=Disc(K)t² and 4AC=B²+d t² bound H. At H=m+1, the index multiplier must be one, and AC>=m(m+1) forces A,C in {m,m+1}, yielding exactly four base forms and two conditional symmetric ones subject to |B|<=H. The monic norm minimum is (d+1)/4. The quadratic squarefree-value theorem gives positive-density eligible parameters. Finite checker tests all optimal-form possibilities for 75 eligible m<=80.

value.rationale: Determines an exact natural field invariant and the entire literal optimizer set for an infinite density-positive discriminant construction lying at the sharp discriminant boundary. The symmetric-exception criterion and exact monic comparison make it a precise reproducible benchmark for projective-vs-monic defining polynomial heights, distinct from the literature’s general existence and asymptotic results.
